fields.name: Biodiversity
fields.description: Failures in AI systems used for species detection, habitat mapping, conservation prioritisation, or ecological monitoring—where failures often stem from biased datasets, misclassification, or poor generalisation across ecosystems.

fields.name: Flooding
fields.description: Failure in AI systems that cover flood‑risk modelling, hydrological prediction, early‑warning systems, and mapping tools. Failures often involve outdated data, incorrect assumptions, or over‑confident visualisations.

fields.name: Urban Planning
fields.description: failures in AI used for land‑use classification, zoning support tools, transport modelling, and infrastructure risk assessments. Failures may arise from scale mismatches, missing socioeconomic context, or misinterpreted outputs.

fields.name: Wildfire Risk & Management
fields.description: Failures in AI used for fire‑risk prediction, smoke‑plume modelling, or satellite‑based detection. Failures can involve false positives/negatives, poor transfer to new regions, or miscommunication of uncertainty.

fields.name: Agricultural & Land‑Use Monitoring
fields.description: Failure in AI systems used for crop health detection, soil moisture estimation, yield prediction, or automated irrigation. Failures often relate to seasonal bias, sensor limitations, or models trained on non‑representative climates.
